items.title: renderer.initTexture on a CompressedArrayTexture with pending layerUpdates: does staging outside render() make the next render's texUploadMs ≈ 0?
items.script: none committed on HEAD — inline recipe below
items.boxMode: 1070, off-screen CDP :9333, in-world session, real render (NOT nullRender — the probe measures GL upload timing)
recipe: 1. Boot in-world (bare default + login flags + ?nosw=1); wait for terrainBakedLbs.size plateau.

2. Arm the stall probe: `window.__stallArm()` (stall_probe.js:102; GL wrap groups texUpload = texSubImage/compressedTexSubImage — stall_probe.js:181; cumulative texUploadMs/Calls/Bytes at :285, an _MS_KEYS attribution field :432).
3. Control arm: force a fresh CompressedArrayTexture (or new layerUpdates on an existing xu7 array) to upload INSIDE the normal render path; snapshot texUploadMs delta across that frame.
4. Probe arm: build the same pending-layerUpdates texture, call `renderer.initTexture(tex)` in an idle callback OUTSIDE render(), then snapshot the NEXT render frame's texUploadMs delta.
5. PASS-shape: probe-arm next-frame texUploadMs ≈ 0 (upload happened at initTexture time); report both deltas + bytes.
6. Renderer handle: via the scene3d module scope or liveScene3d snapshot — note liveScene3d is a one-time init3D snapshot (stall_probe.js:430–435), stamped ~35 s after in-world; poll not-null.
items.expects: texUploadMs(next frame) ≈ 0 on the initTexture arm; both arms' ms+bytes recorded
